_comment: Expectations for Test-VhcLiveRun.ps1 -Check CsvOutputs. Keys are CSV names without the hostname prefix, leading underscore and .csv (Servers = <host>_Servers.csv). The CSV list itself is enumerated from the collector source. 'required'/'labCommon'/'profiles' say which CSVs must exist and be non-empty; anything not listed is feature-dependent: may be absent, but must have a valid header when present. Export-VhciCsv writes no file for zero records, so a listed CSV that is missing means its collector found nothing or failed. 'columns' says which columns a CSV must carry: the columns the C# report reads (reader file:line in each 'reader'), not whatever the hand-written golden baselines list. A CSV without a 'columns' entry falls back to golden baselines plus ObjectSchemas requiredColumns. Most collectors pipe a Veeam cmdlet's objects straight to Export-VhciCsv, so their column set is the cmdlet's property set; 'dropped' records golden columns that run 38984338014 showed the live output does not have and that no reader consumes. 'knownGaps' are columns a reader consumes that the collector does not write (a product bug, logged as INFO, not enforced). 'emptyFileOk' CSVs are created unconditionally and are a zero-byte file when there is nothing to report.

required.vbrinfo: every VBR server reports its version (Get-VhcVbrInfo always emits one row)
required.Servers: every VBR server lists at least itself (Get-VBRServer)
required.Proxies: every VBR server has a default VMware backup proxy
required.Repositories: every VBR server has at least the Default Backup Repository
required.Jobs: the labs run jobs; an empty Jobs.csv means job discovery broke (also asserted by RowCounts)
required.LicInfo: every VBR server has a license object (Community edition included)
required.SecurityCompliance: Security & Compliance Analyzer always returns best-practice rows on VBR 12+
required.UserRoles: every VBR server has at least the installing admin role assignment
required.configBackup: every VBR server has a configuration backup job object (enabled or not)
required.orphanedSupersededBackupsMeta: one-row signal file, written unconditionally by Get-VhcOrphanedSupersededBackups
required.AllServersRequirementsComparison: concurrency analysis emits a row for every server role; written on all three labs
required.CollectionManifest: written unconditionally at the end of Get-VBRConfig.ps1 (not in the collector log, so not observed in run 38980131816)
